g.desc: Trust boundary: Payment services (5 components). Application execution serves ×5 it; Keep state serves ×6 it; Connect serves ×6 it; Identity and access decisions serves ×5 it; Operate serves ×6 it.
Logical technology component TC-001: Application execution (compute). It serves ×5 Payment services; depends on Connect; depends on Operate.
Capability family: Keep state (3 capabilities). It serves ×6 Payment services.
Capability family: Connect (2 capabilities). It serves ×6 Payment services; depends on Identity and access decisions; depends on Operate. Application execution depends on it.
Technology service TC-006: Identity and access decisions (identity). It serves ×5 Payment services. Connect depends on it.
Capability family: Operate (2 capabilities). It serves ×6 Payment services. Application execution depends on it; Connect depends on it.
